titleEn: Twitter Spaces: Confrontation with suspended journalists
titleZh: Twitter Spaces：与被停权记者的对峙
summaryEn: Shortly after Twitter suspended several journalists over the @ElonJet tracking row, Musk briefly joined a Twitter Space where the suspended reporters confronted him about the bans; he left after a few minutes and the Space shut down.
summaryZh: 在Twitter因@ElonJet追踪争议暂停数名记者的账号后不久，马斯克短暂加入了一个Twitter Space，被暂停账号的记者在那里就封禁一事与他对质；几分钟后他离开了，Space也随即关闭。

segments.textEn: Well, as I'm sure everyone who's been docs would agree, you know, showing real time information about somebody's location is inappropriate. And I think everyone on this call would not like that to be known to them. And there is not going to be any distinction in the future between journalists, so called journalists, and regular people. Everyone's going to be treated the same. You're not special because you're a journalist.
segments.textZh: 嗯，我相信每个被docs过的人都会同意，你知道，展示某人位置的实时信息是不恰当的。而且我认为这次通话中的每个人都不希望别人知道他们的这种信息。以后不会再对记者、所谓的记者和普通人加以区分。每个人都会受到同样的对待。你不会因为是记者就很特殊。

segments.textEn: You're just, you're a Twitter, you're just, you're a citizen. So no special treatment.
segments.textZh: 你只是，你是一个Twitter，你只是，你是一个公民。所以没有特殊待遇。

segments.textEn: You dox, you get suspended, end of story.
segments.textZh: 你开盒，就会被暂停账号，事情就这么简单。

segments.textEn: So, and ban evasion. Ban evasion. Or like, or trying to be clever about it, like, oh, I posted a link to the real time information is obviously, that is obviously simply trying to evade the meaning. That is there's no different from pen and paste than actually showing real time information.
segments.textZh: 所以，还有规避封禁。规避封禁。或者像是，或者试图在这件事上耍聪明，比如，哦，我发布了一个实时信息的链接，这显然，这显然只是在试图规避其含义。那与实际展示实时信息相比，用笔和粘贴并没有什么不同。

segments.textEn: So when you're saying posting a link to it, I mean, some of the people like Drew and Ryan Mack from the New York Times who were banned were, you know, they were reporting on it in the course of sort of pretty normal journalistic endeavors. You consider that like a tricky attempt at ban evasion.
segments.textZh: 所以，当你说发布它的链接时，我是说，像Drew和《纽约时报》的Ryan Mack这样一些被封禁的人，你知道，他们是在进行某种相当正常的新闻报道时报道这件事。你认为那是一种企图规避封禁的狡猾做法。

segments.textEn: You show the link to the real time information. Ban evasion. Obviously,
segments.textZh: 你展示了实时信息的链接。规避封禁。显然，

segments.textEn: Drew, I don't think you were posting the real time information. Right.
segments.textZh: Drew，我认为你并没有发布实时信息。对吧。

segments.textEn: I mean, you're suggesting that we're sharing your address, which is not true. And you're suggesting that we're posting.
segments.textZh: 我是说，你在暗示我们分享了你的地址，但这并不属实。而且你在暗示我们正在发布。
我从未发布过你的地址。

segments.textEn: You posted a link to the address.
segments.textZh: 你发布了那个地址的链接。

segments.textEn: We posted a link. In the course of reporting about Elonjet, we posted links to elonjet, which are now not online and now banned on Twitter. Using, you know, we have to admit, acknowledge using the same exact link blocking technique that you have criticized as part of the Hunter Biden New York post story in 2020. So what is different here and there?
